task_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the task

role.description: Specialized agent role assigned to execute this task

scope.description: List of directories or files in scope

constraints.description: Execution constraints (e.g. read-only, no nested delegation, single-writer)

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete criteria for considering the task completed

dependencies.description: List of task_ids this task depends on

context.description: Optional context findings handed down from Main or earlier tasks
